thread:
alex_sales: Customer FinEdge — preflight for POC. Key asks: 10k queries/day, burst up to 500 rps, acceptance targets p50<=150ms and p95<=400ms, cost target ~<$1k for a 30-day POC. They require KMS control, VPC peering option, and SOC2 artifacts. Need runbook + pricing estimate + security answers. Who can own?

molly_se: I can own the runbook and tech handoff. Quick Q — are they strict about private (VPC) from day 1 or ok with hosted + VPC peering later?

jamal_ml: For burst 500 rps we should plan a staged load test and test with quantized models. Recommend start on r/w: gpt-small-8q (primary) + gpt-medium fallback in routing policy. Need sample prompts and expected output labels for evals. Also will instrument KV cache hit rates.

alex_sales: They said they'd prefer VPC/KMS but can do hosted for initial soak if we can demonstrate encryption + key control. Sending sample prompts below. Also need a ballpark POC burn estimate (30 days, 10k q/day).

sofia_prod: Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Prompt evals >=92% relevance on provided testset; 2) Latency: p50<=150ms, p95<=400ms under burst profile; 3) Total POC cost <=$1k; 4) Security: KMS-managed keys, TLS in transit, and documentation for retention and deletion. I'll capture as checklist.

alex_sales: ```
# sample_prompts.txt
prompt_1: "Summarize invoice line items into category, amount, vendor."
prompt_2: "Given customer support chat, extract intent and urgency (high/med/low)."
prompt_3: "Rewrite policy paragraph to 2-sentence summary for compliance review."

# quick api check (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-small-8q","input":"Summarize invoice...","max_tokens":150}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```

jamal_ml: I'll build the eval harness. Plan: 3-stage load test: 1) warmup 50 rps 15m, 2) sustained 250 rps 30m, 3) peak 500 rps 10m. Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit rate, tokens/sec, tail latencies per model variant. If p95 breaches 400ms, fallbacks: increase batch size, enable quantized execution path, or route to fallback model. Also will run cost sim with typical prompt length distribution.

security_bot: Security questionnaire logged: FinEdge asked for SOC2 Type II, KMS integration guide, VPC peering steps, and data retention policy. Docs: https://internal.docs.redwood/security/presales (attach). Please upload required bits to the customer locker.

molly_se: Owners & timeline: Molly (SE) — runbook + infra setup; Jamal (ML) — eval harness + perf report; Sofia (Prod) — acceptance checklist + gating; Alex (Sales) — NDA, sample data, and customer coordination. Target milestones: env ready by Wed, load tests Thu-Fri, report & recommendation by next Mon.

alex_sales: I'll get NDA and sample data. Pricing note from customer: they'd like committed vs PAYG comparison. Can we provide a delta estimate for a 30-day reserved capacity vs hosted PAYG?

ops_oncall: Ops notes: For POC we can spin up a dedicated trial pool but SLA is best-effort until contract. Dedicated reserved capacity supports enterprise SLA (e.g., 99.9% uptime) once provisioned. Tagging infra for capacity check and block scheduling.

alex_sales: Perfect — I'll send calendar invites for kickoff and include checklist. If anyone sees blockers (billing, infra quotas, legal), flag here. :thumbsup:
